ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with high-intensity (white) pixels occupying approximately 85% of the central surface area and low-intensity (black) pixels localized at the perimeter and trailing edge.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white region across the central interior of both lobes; low-intensity black border forms an irregular perimeter along the trailing edge and thickens into large terminal clusters at the lateral distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central indentation with an acute angle and a significant depth-to-width ratio relative to the fluke midline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and frequent serrations along the horizontal trailing edge boundary, exhibiting a saw-tooth pattern with significant pixel-depth variations (notches) of 5-15 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward curve defining the upper margins of the lobes, terminating in rounded, thickened distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertically oriented low-intensity linear pixel streaks visible on the ventral surface of the inner right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular notch and jagged indentation visible on the trailing edge of the right lobe, indicating localized tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced, bulbous black pigmentation at the distal tips of both lobes, creating a distinct color-block profile.
